Revision: Continuous clean-reference confidence replaces thresholded activity control

Control.TargetGain: Nominal gain + combined confidence * (bounded measured gain - nominal gain)

Benchmark.Method: Isolated copies of the actual processors, rotated order, warmed code, construction excluded. CompleteProcessor includes native pitch shifting and completion. MixAndCorrectionOnly invokes the actual renderer with prepared harmony buffers; its inputs are synthetic. Timing and allocation samples exclude input preparation.
